adk-tutorial.title: ADK Tutorial
adk-tutorial.description: This tutorial covers how to create agents, create and manage models, and run or modify agents using the Agent Development Kit (ADK). Before beginning, ensure:

API/agent-interface.title: AgentInterface
API/agent-interface.description: Abstract class to define interacting with a purely RL agent.

API/base-agent.title: BaseAgent
API/base-agent.description: Abstract class to define interacting with a combined AgentInterface and Gymnasium Env at the same time. This class extends AgentInterface and gymnasium.Env.

API/base-executor.title: BaseExecutor
API/base-executor.description: Abstract class that serves as the foundation for executing optimization tasks. Extends Thread and ABC to provide concurrent execution capabilities for optimization workflows.

API/connector.title: Connector
API/connector.description: The main connector class that manages the WebSocket connection between the agent and the AsterQuanta platform. Handles heartbeat messages, incoming requests, and task lifecycle management.

API/Environments/optimization-env.title: OptimizationEnv
API/Environments/optimization-env.description: Abstract class to define an environment for interacting with optimizable systems. Highly recommended

API/Models/agent-data.title: AgentData
API/Models/agent-data.description: Data class representing the agent's optimization-related state

API/Models/environment-data.title: EnvData
API/Models/environment-data.description: Data class encapsulating environment configuration and agent-environment interaction parameters

API/Models/genie-model.title: Genie Model
API/Models/genie-model.description: A high-level data class that structures all necessary information required by an agent for

API/Models/hyper-parameters.title: Hyper Parameters
API/Models/hyper-parameters.description: Hyperparameters are configurable values set before training a model that govern the learning

API/Models/metadata.title: Metadata
API/Models/metadata.description: A data class that is used to define and manage key information of a Genie Model.

API/Models/target-specifications.title: Target Specifications
API/Models/target-specifications.description: A dataclass that captures all necessary data to represent a target that an agent can achieve.

API/Models/world-controls.title: World Controls
API/Models/world-controls.description: A dataclass that is helpful in defining the action space and mapping design parameters.

what-to-do-next.title: What To Do Next
what-to-do-next.description: Now that you have your agent set up and running, let's go beyond the basics and explore advanced development features. You'll learn how to add, modify, commit, and delete models — as well as how to restore deleted models.
